newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 9.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Monday and main factors likely to affect trading:
* Manila stocks are likely to open week on Monday due to concerns over rising instances of corporate loan defauts.

* Newspaper reports of alleged irregularities involving about 500 million pesos worth of refined sugar delivery orders/receipts used as collateral for bank loans extended by banks to Victorias Milling Corp and its subsidiaries could weaken the banking sector, said Nathan Lozada, analyst at Philippine Asia Equity Securities.
* Manuel Goseco, economist at Dharmala Securities, said he expected buying to shift to select secondliners such as Belle Corp which are now trading at bargain levels.
* Manila stocks are expected to generally ignore loast Frdiay's record rise in the Dow Jones index.
* On Friday, the Manila stock index dropped 15.64 points to 2,762.80.
